label: Braced and waiting
summary: Pressure on Iran tightened rather than eased. CENTCOM launched a task force to choke Iran's land supply routes as explosions were reported on Qeshm and two tankers hit mines near Hormuz, though Qatari-mediated talks continue. A gunman killed six in Krakow's main square, Russia hit power facilities around Kyiv, and a drone attack on a Colombian army base killed three soldiers. More than 140,000 marched against living costs in France. Heavy rain flooded thousands of tents in Gaza, and a magnitude 5.7 quake injured more than 20 in central Japan. Brighter notes: Pope Leo drew large crowds in Uruguay, Tanzania's Tundu Lissu was cleared of treason though jailed for four years, and New Zealand counted its votes calmly towards a hung result. COP31 opens tomorrow in Antalya. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
